description: Parses a flipcode document, returning the normalized canonical code, any warnings (out-of-range values are clamped, unknown lines ignored), a board summary, and links: a share URL that opens the exact board in the FlipLetters Studio, and an open-with-code URL that also reveals the code panel. Use this after drafting a board; fix warnings and re-validate until clean, then give the human the share link.
name: flipletters_validate_board

shareUrl.description: Opens this exact board in the Studio. Null when the board is too large for a URL — share the code text instead.

title: Validate a board
